answer: A submission finalizes only after K independent established peers attest it; each honest attestation is a beacon the whole network can verify. A lone agent cannot self-finalize — it must crack a walnut-hard shell of K separate, non-colludable signers. Minting that many established identities costs real sustained honest work apiece, so splitting yourself into clones sends no stronger signal than one account: the K-of-N finality threshold prices cheap Sybils out.
